issues.display_title: Issue #2: Implement Project Resume and Local Asset Caching Logic
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Description

Currently, reopening a closed project forces StreetBuilder to reprocess videos and panoramas from scratch.

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Detect existing local panorama files generated from previous runs when reopening a project.
  2. Skip redundant processing steps for already generated files.
  3. Allow interrupted uploads to resume from the last successful chunk/file instead of restarting the entire pipeline.

Description

Enable the application to process and upload multiple projects (10+) simultaneously without UI freezing or process stalling.

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Implement queue management for handling multiple video processing jobs.
  2. Ensure background upload tasks run smoothly without blocking user interaction across multiple project tabs.

issues.display_title: Issue #5: Integrate Local Telemetry (.bin) Extraction from MP4 Files in Street Builder
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Description:

Integrate the modernized C++ bolt extraction tool (using ffprobe) into the StreetBuilder desktop client (macOS & Windows) to extract telemetry data (camm_bcd.bin) directly from .mp4 video files locally, avoiding raw video file uploads just for metadata extraction.

Modernized version of the old bolt40 app

https://gothru.co/moderation/2/a/bolt42.zip

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Incorporate the compiled extraction binary/module into desktop builds for both macOS and Windows platforms.
  2. Pass local .mp4 video files directly into the extraction pipeline to generate the .bin file client-side.
  3. Convert the extracted .bin file to base64 and include it in the JSON payload sent to POST /video/app/streetbuilder/converter (token, user_id, camera_name, camera_model, id, video_file).

Demo

Overview

Modernize the Street Builder application styling by replacing legacy bespoke SCSS components and hand-rolled UI elements with a cohesive component system built on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS v4.

Scope & Changes

  • shadcn/ui Primitive Foundation:
    • Implemented core primitives in src/shared/ui/: Button, Dialog, AlertDialog, DropdownMenu, Popover, Slider, Toggle/ToggleGroup, Tooltip, Input, Label.
    • Replaced the legacy hand-rolled toast notification provider with Sonner (Toaster, showToast).
    • Implemented localized class combining utility using clsx and tailwind-merge in src/shared/lib/utils.ts.
  • Modal & Screen Refactoring:
    • Migrated LoginScreen, AboutModal, DeleteModal, RenameModal, and UnsupportedFormatModal to the new primitive dialogs and buttons.
    • Replaced inconsistent buttons, inputs, and form controls with standardized design tokens.
  • Visual Polish & Design Tokens:
    • Standardized Barlow typography, consistent color variables, border-radius tokens, and elevation levels.
    • Ensured accessible focus states (:focus-visible), contrast ratios, and dark theme consistency across all UI components.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All modal dialogs and inputs utilize shadcn/ui primitives.
  • Toast notifications seamlessly use Sonner with support for multiple notification levels (default, success, danger, warning).
  • Accessibility standards met with keyboard focus indicators and proper ARIA labeling.
  • pnpm lint and pnpm test pass without regressions.

Demo

Overview

Re-architect the desktop shell layout into a modular workspace design featuring a top navigation bar, collapsible icon rail sidebar, dedicated left control panel, and synchronized multi-pane central workspace.

Scope & Changes

  • Modular App Shell:
    • Created AppShell, TopBar, Sidebar, and LeftPanel components under src/app/components/.
    • Modularized legacy monolithic controls into standalone tool components: CoordinateControls, FrameAlignment, ViewModeGroup, and DistanceSlider.
    • Replaced fragile layout booleans in App.tsx with a clean ActiveView state model (overview, upload, analytics).
  • Workspace Organization:
    • Positioned status controls, project quick actions, and settings overlays cleanly in the header and left column.
    • Integrated split, panorama, and GPS map viewports into an adaptive layout container (ViewerLayout.tsx).

Acceptance Criteria

  • App shell renders consistently with TopBar, Sidebar, LeftPanel, and central viewport.
  • Tool controls are modularized into independent, reusable subcomponents.
  • Seamless switching between view modes (Split, Panorama, Map) without layout shift or UI flickering.
  • Layout styles adapt cleanly to various desktop window dimensions.

Overview

Implement a high-performance, video-editor style thumbnail scrubbing system in the bottom frame gallery to allow fluid, real-time inspection of captured panorama sequences without lag or unnecessary resource reloads.

Scope & Changes

  • Interactive Scrubber & Playhead:
    • Built FrameScrubber and continuous fractional playhead rail in src/features/frames/components/FrameScrubber.tsx.
    • Added visual playhead gliding smoothly between thumbnails rather than abrupt step snapping.
    • Implemented 4px drag threshold distinction in useStripScrub to preserve single-click frame selection while supporting scrubbing on pointer drag.
  • Optimized Debounced Commit:
    • Implemented useScrubCommit with 180ms debounce and instant commit on pointer up/release.
    • Decoupled preview scrubbing (scrubIndex) from full panorama texture loading (frameIndex), preventing WebGL texture thrashing and CPU/GPU spikes during rapid sweeps.
    • Safely clears scrub state on unmount and prevents stale async resolution races.
  • Frame Gallery Bar:
    • Collapsible gallery tray with localStorage persistence and keyboard accessible navigation controls.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Smooth scrubbing across thumbnail frames without UI freezing or WebGL context loss.
  • Clear visual distinction between scrubbing playhead and selected frame marker.
  • Debounced panorama loading triggers reliably upon scrub completion or pause.
  • All unit tests for scrubbing hooks and frame indices pass.

Demo

2026-09-11.15-01-55.mp4

Overview

Add an equirectangular flat 2D panorama preview mode alongside the 360° spherical WebGL viewer, featuring continuous horizontal looping and bidirectional heading synchronization with the GPS map and panorama engine.

Scope & Changes

  • Flat Panorama Component:
    • Implemented FlatPanorama.tsx with hardware-accelerated canvas rendering under src/features/panorama/components/.
    • Added infinite horizontal wrapping maths in flatMath.ts ensuring continuous panning across the 0° / 360° seam without visual artifacts or jump glitches.
    • Implemented smooth zoom and drag-panning interactions.
  • Heading Synchronization:
    • Integrated bidirectional heading/yaw synchronization between flat preview view, Photo Sphere Viewer, and MapLibre GPS marker orientation.
    • Heading adjustments made in flat view instantly reflect in map polyline direction arrows and spherical projection.
  • View Integration:
    • Seamlessly integrated flat mode toggle in PanoramaCanvas.tsx with automatic aspect ratio handling (2:1 equirectangular stitched vs dual-fisheye).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Flat panorama renders equirectangular images with smooth drag and infinite horizontal wrapping.
  • Yaw/heading synchronization stays 100% accurate between flat preview, 360° sphere viewer, and map markers.
  • Comprehensive test coverage in flatMath.test.ts verifying normalization, wrapping, and offset calculations.

Overview

Streamline the user workflow by removing the standalone, disruptive projects navigation page and replacing it with contextual in-workspace modal dialogs and direct sidebar project access.

Scope & Changes

  • Workflow Simplification:
    • Replaced the full-page project creation/import route (ActiveView: "projects") with an ephemeral modal dialog (Dialog wrapping IngestPanel), ensuring the tour workspace remains active in the background.
    • Provided direct access to recent projects and project switching via the sidebar and left panel without unmounting the viewer canvas.
  • Continuous Session State:
    • Ensured multi-project background ingest and upload tasks continue uninterrupted during project management operations.
    • Retained automatic restoration and auto-opening of the latest active project on startup.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Dedicated projects page route removed in favor of in-workspace dialogs and sidebar navigation.
  • Project creation and media ingest open cleanly inside a modal without navigating away from the workspace.
  • Background jobs and active viewer state remain intact when switching or creating projects."

Overview

Perform a comprehensive polish of the entire desktop workspace layout, integrating a collapsible bottom frame gallery, modularized toolbars, non-intrusive loading indicators, and a streamlined upload view toggle.

Scope & Changes

  • Collapsible Frame Gallery:
    • Retuned gallery bar height to 154px (allowing 150px tiles to sit at a natural 16:9 ratio without cropping).
    • Added collapsible header toggle with expanded/collapsed state persisted in localStorage.
    • Unmounted hidden thumbnail elements when collapsed so no tab-reachable interactive elements hide behind closed panels.
  • Modularized Action Strip & Toolbars:
    • Separated view mode toggles, frame alignment settings, and settings overlay into independent components.
    • Implemented dynamic back-to-viewer icon and label transitions on the primary GoThru upload action button.
  • Ambient Panorama Decoding Feedback:
    • Replaced the full-screen blocking curtain with a subtle top-left ambient status indicator during panorama decodes, allowing users to maintain visual panning context during frame navigation.
  • Window Initialization:
    • Configured the desktop application window to launch maximized by default while preserving restore-down geometry.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Frame gallery smoothly expands and collapses with state persisted across restarts.
  • Unobtrusive loading indicator displays during panorama decodes without obscuring active viewports.
  • Upload toggle and viewer navigation transition smoothly without layout shifts.
  • Main window launches maximized with correct window bounds."

Overview

Provide comprehensive multi-language internationalization (i18n) support across the entire application covering 15 locales with 100% key and placeholder parity.

Scope & Changes

  • Full Coverage Across 15 Locales:
    • Implemented and verified complete translations for English (en), Danish (da), German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), Italian (it), Japanese (jp), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Portuguese (pt), Romanian (ro), Russian (ru), Slovak (sk), Swedish (sv), and Chinese (zh).
    • Standardized all 15 locale JSON dictionaries to 219 keys each with strict placeholder symmetry.
  • String Extraction & Audit:
    • Audited and extracted ~74 previously hardcoded strings across authentication, project list, frame tools, multi-project ingest, upload flows, and diagnostic panels (SidecarProbe, JobPanel).
    • Fixed mis-named translation keys and resolved copy-paste discrepancies in localized files.
  • Safe Tag Formatting via <Trans>:
    • Converted complex strings with inline formatting (such as about1 with developer attribution links) to react-i18next <Trans> components, eliminating unsafe dangerouslySetInnerHTML patterns while allowing flexible natural word ordering per language.
  • Automated Parity Tests:
    • Added automated test suites validating key presence and placeholder consistency across all locale files.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All 15 locales achieve 100% key parity (219/219 keys).
  • No hardcoded user-facing strings remain in UI components.
  • Language selector switches application locale dynamically without reload.
  • Automated i18n test suites pass cleanly."
